dialogues.speaker: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Our store is currently negotiating with merchants, the supply of Silk Flowers will be resumed soon.

dialogues.speaker: Ogura Textiles & Kimonos Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Please do not worry — you can take advance orders from us, and work will begin in good order once the silks arrive.
